title: Azusawa Kohane — Chasing After Everyone〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Weekend Garage

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Our set list is good to go, so I think we can end things here for today.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: An, about tomorrow... I'll be practicing on my own, so I might not be able to come by your place until it gets dark.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
No problem!
Wait, don't you always sing on Vivid Street? I might just come by and watch you!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: That'd defeat the point of her practicing.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: What are you saying? I'm just gonna go and check things out.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm sure you'll be fine, but call us if you need anything, okay?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Thanks, I will. See you tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright, we should head home too...

rows.Speaker: Youth
rows.Line: Found you! Akito! Toya!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Who is that...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh, he works for one of the live houses we perform at often.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What's up? Did someone drop out of an event or something?

rows.Speaker: Youth
rows.Line: No, it's not that! That guy... The jerk from the next town over's back!!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hold on. What's he talking about?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: A musician that likes to make trouble...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: He look for people doing solo performances so that he can cut in unannounced and ruin the mood for everyone.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: What?! Seriously?!

rows.Speaker: Youth
rows.Line: Yeah, didn't he come and try to start something with you guys when you were still the BAD DOGS?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: He did. I still remember.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah. At least you showed him who's boss and made him run back to his own turf...

rows.Speaker: Youth
rows.Line:
Man, he's such a pain.
On top of that, all he does is go after singers that are just starting out.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wait, so just new people?!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Kohane... I hope you're safe...)
The next day
Main Street

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Thank you!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (So many people have gathered here today. I should try singing more and more different songs then...)

rows.Speaker: Musician
rows.Line:
Hey, you...
Wanna try singing together...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Is this the thing An was talking about where other musicians jump and do spontaneous sessions with you...?)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I've joined other people before, but I've never had anyone ask me...!)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Y-Yes, of course...!

rows.Speaker: Musician
rows.Line:
Thanks. Let's get started...
————♪

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh? Wait...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Whenever An does something like this, she usually talks with whoever's performing first...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I guess improvising is another way to go too. His voice is pretty low, so maybe I can go high.)

rows.Speaker: Spectator A
rows.Line: Whoa! She's harmonizing perfectly!

rows.Speaker: Spectator B
rows.Line: Yeah! Wait, are they doing a battle right now...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Oh, he's trying to be more aggressive now... Maybe that's just how he sings...?)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Harmonizing with him went pretty well, so I guess I can try copying him now. Something like this...?)

rows.Speaker: Spectator A
rows.Line:
She's unreal!
I didn't know she could sing with this kind of flare!

rows.Speaker: Spectator B
rows.Line: You go, girl!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I've gotten used to performing on my own, but it really is just more fun to sing with other people...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Phew... Thank you very much!

rows.Speaker: Musician
rows.Line: *Huff*... *Huff*... Dammit...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Um, thank you for singing with me just now! It was a lot of fun!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Huh? Why's he leering at me like that? Did I do something wrong?!)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: There you are! Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: An! You really came to watch?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, but let's go somewhere more private for now.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh? Wait, An...!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Long time no see, Mr. Troublemaker...

rows.Speaker: Musician
rows.Line: B-BAD DOGS...?!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
No, there's four of us now.
We're Vivid BAD SQUAD.

rows.Speaker: Musician
rows.Line: H-Hold on, that little kid... She's with you...?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: If you like singing so much, we'll come play. It's much more fun that way.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: So, what's it gonna be...?

rows.Speaker: Musician
rows.Line: Um...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: What?! H-He's famous for being a troublemaker?! I just sang with him like it was nothing...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hahaha! Like it was nothing...?!
That's my partner for you...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe... But will we be okay? Are you sure he won't come back...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Not for some time.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah. He lost to a shrimp like you, so it's gonna be a while before he can show his face anywhere again.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hey, don't call her a shrimp!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh? It's true, right?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You two...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (It feels like I'm actually making good progress.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I need to keep this up! I need to keep going so that I can catch up with everyone as soon as possible!)
